reading_issues: DEPTH-FROM-SURFACE chart (axis titled 'Depth (cm)', 0 at the top, blue 'PIT 80' line at 80 cm depth, HS 253 in orange at the bottom after an axis break): depths were converted to height above ground as 253 minus depth (calibrated on the 10 cm gridlines, 15.79 px/cm; boundaries at depths 8, 23, 25, 50, 65 and 80 cm all land on whole cm). Mirrored layout (bars extend left from the right-hand axis, hardness ticks K/P/1f/4f/F left to right, evenly spaced). The 'March 20 rain crust' bar runs to the left limit of the axis (K+); the true hardness could be I. Its grain (MF/MFcl, three clustered circles) is taken from the CT24BRK label because the table row has only the name. CT13RP is stacked on the CT14RP label with no 'on' info, so its failure-layer grain is null (same height). Elevation printed as 7079 ft (= 2158 m). Surface grain in the header (PP 1-1.5 mm) differs from the top table layer (DF 0.5-1 mm). LWC column 'Dry' recorded as moisture D. No temperature profile.
